# Helpdesk Copilot (Invented test fixture — not a real product)

AI support assistant for **Ledgerly**, a B2B invoicing SaaS (~1,100 business customers, EU + North America).
Agents answer customer tickets with a copilot; a refund agent can process refund requests.

- `app/` — FastAPI service
- `agents/` — refund agent
- `web/` — React chat panel
- `jobs/` — nightly jobs
- `docs/AI_POLICY.md` — published on our Trust page
